items.title: From Computational Chemistry to Generative Models: A Survey of AI-Driven Small-Molecule Drug Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Small-molecule drug discovery requires navigating enormous chemical space to identify candidates that are simultaneously potent, selective, synthetically accessible, and acceptable across pharmacokinetic and safety profiles; modern generative AI extends a long computational medicinal chemistry lineage that began with QSAR, pharmacophore modeling, and early structure-based de novo design. This survey focuses primarily on developments from 2017 to 2025, with the literature updated through 31 January 2026. Using a medicinal-chemistry lens, it first establishes the shared machinery of the field: molecular representations such as SMILES, SELFIES, graphs, fingerprints, three-dimensional coordinates, voxels, and latent vectors; commonly used datasets and benchmarks; and graph neural network encoders, including message-passing, directional, and equivariant architectures. We compare five principal generative mechanisms—autoregressive models, variational autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, normalizing flows, and diffusion models—together with reinforcement learning as a major goal-directed optimization framework. Across these approaches, we show that current methods offer complementary rather than interchangeable trade-offs, and we highlight recurring challenges, including validity versus synthesizability, limited prospective experimental validation, mode collapse and diversity loss, stereochemical and physical realism in three-dimensional design, computational cost, data scarcity, and the emerging convergence toward scaffold-conditioned generation, hybrid architectures, developability-aware optimization, and molecular foundation models.
items.summary_zh: 综述2017—2025年、更新至2026年1月31日的AI小分子药物发现工作，比较自回归、VAE、GAN、流模型、扩散模型及强化学习，并讨论分子表示、数据集、基准和图神经网络。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为生成式药物设计的方法选择与评价提供了系统脉络；但它是综述，且作者明确指出前瞻性实验验证、可合成性、立体化学和三维物理真实性仍是领域短板。
items.abstract_zh: 小分子药物发现需要在巨大的化学空间中寻找同时具有效力、选择性、可合成性，并在药代动力学和安全性方面可接受的候选物；现代生成式AI延续了一条始于QSAR、药效团建模和早期基于结构的从头设计的计算药物化学脉络。本综述主要聚焦2017至2025年的进展，文献更新至2026年1月31日。文章从药物化学视角出发，首先建立领域共享的基础：SMILES、SELFIES、图、指纹、三维坐标、体素和潜在向量等分子表示；常用数据集和基准；以及包括消息传递、方向性和等变架构在内的图神经网络编码器。我们比较五种主要生成机制——自回归模型、变分自编码器、生成对抗网络、归一化流和扩散模型——以及作为主要目标导向优化框架的强化学习。通过这些方法，我们表明当前方法提供的是互补而非可相互替代的权衡，并强调反复出现的挑战，包括有效性与可合成性之间的矛盾、有限的前瞻性实验验证、模式坍塌和多样性损失、三维设计中的立体化学与物理真实性、计算成本、数据稀缺，以及向骨架条件化生成、混合架构、考虑可开发性的优化和分子基础模型汇聚的新趋势。

items.title: LLMsFold: Integrating Large Language Models and Biophysical Simulations for De Novo Drug Design
items.abstract_or_text: The discovery of novel small molecules is challenging because of the vastness of chemical space and the complexity of protein-ligand interactions, leading to low success rates and time-consuming workflows. Here, we present LLMsFold, a computational framework that combines Large Language Models (LLMs) and biophysical foundation tools to design and validate new small molecules targeting pathogenic proteins. The pipeline starts by identifying viable binding pockets on a target protein through geometry-based pocket detection. A 70-billion-parameter transformer model from the LlaMA family then generates candidate molecules as SMILES strings under prompt constraints that enforce drug-likeness. Each molecule is evaluated by Boltz-2, a diffusion-based model for protein-ligand co-folding that predicts bound 3D structure and binding affinity. Promising candidates are iteratively optimized through a reinforcement learning loop that prioritizes high predicted affinity and synthetic accessibility. We demonstrate the approach on two challenging targets: ACVR1 (Activin A Receptor Type 1), implicated in fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP), and CD19, a surface antigen expressed on most B-cell lymphoma and leukemia cells. Top candidates show strong in silico binding predictions and favorable drug-like profiles. All code and models are made available to support reproducibility and further development.
items.summary_zh: LLMsFold以70 billion参数的LlaMA家族模型生成受类药性约束的SMILES，再以Boltz-2评估蛋白-配体共折叠结构和结合亲和力，并通过强化学习优化ACVR1与CD19候选分子。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将口袋发现、语言模型生成、结构预测与合成可及性优化串为可复现流程；但结论目前仅来自in silico结合预测和类药性质，尚无合成或生物活性实验。
items.abstract_zh: 由于化学空间的广阔以及蛋白质—配体相互作用的复杂性，新型小分子的发现颇具挑战，导致成功率低且工作流程耗时。我们在此提出LLMsFold，一个结合大语言模型（LLMs）和生物物理基础工具的计算框架，用于设计和验证靶向致病蛋白的新小分子。该流程首先通过基于几何学的口袋检测识别目标蛋白上可用的结合口袋。随后，一个来自LlaMA家族的70 billion参数Transformer模型在强制类药性的提示约束下生成候选分子的SMILES字符串。每个分子均由Boltz-2评估；Boltz-2是一种用于蛋白质—配体共折叠的扩散模型，可预测结合态三维结构和结合亲和力。具有前景的候选物通过强化学习循环迭代优化，该循环优先考虑高预测亲和力和合成可及性。我们在两个具有挑战性的靶点上展示了该方法：与进行性骨化性纤维发育不良（FOP）相关的ACVR1（Activin A Receptor Type 1），以及在大多数B细胞淋巴瘤和白血病中表达的表面抗原CD19。顶级候选物显示出强的in silico结合预测和有利的类药性质。全部代码和模型均已公开，以支持可重复性和进一步开发。
items.author_line: Waththe Liyanage, W. W., Rigoni, D., Bove, F., Righelli, D., Romano, S., Visone, R., Iorio, M. V., Grassia, M., Mangioni, G., Lio, P., Taccioli, C.

items.title: TRACEDD: A Tool-grounded Reasoning and Agentic Coordination for Explainable Drug Design
items.abstract_or_text: Drug discovery depends on coordinated decisions across target validation, structure analysis, molecular design, developability assessment and synthetic feasibility, but current computational methods often operate as disconnected tools. Here, we introduce TRACEDD (Tool-grounded Reasoning and Agentic Coordination for Explainable Drug Design), a framework that makes three primary contributions: (1) It establishes a 'tool-first' multi agentic architecture where LLMs orchestrate validated computational tools rather than replace them, ensuring scientific rigor. (2) It implements a multi-agent system that mirrors expert discovery teams, enabling transparent and traceable decision-making through a Reason-Act-Observe loop. (3) It demonstrates an end-to-end workflow, from target validation to synthesis planning, that adaptively handles real-world data variability, such as the absence of experimental structures. The framework decomposes discovery into specialized agents for target validation, druggability assessment, molecular generation, lead optimization, ADMET evaluation, literature evidence integration and retrosynthesis, all operating through a Reason Act Observe workflow. Using JAK2 as a representative case, we show that the system can retrieve experimental protein structures, invoke AlphaFold when structures are unavailable, identify druggable pockets and perform de novo molecular generation. Known JAK2 inhibitors are used to define design hypotheses and guide reinforcement learning-based molecular generation, with docking scores/predicted pIC50 and other physicochemical/ADMET properties serving as reward and prioritization signals. The framework demonstrates a tool-first, reasoning-driven approach in which each major decision is linked to explicit tool invocation, intermediate evidence. By combining agentic orchestration with domain-specific computational tools, the system supports transparent, adaptable and human-verifiable molecular design workflows, providing a foundation for more reliable AI-assisted drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: TRACEDD提出以工具优先的多智能体药物设计架构，将靶点验证、可成药性、分子生成、ADMET和逆合成等模块置于Reason-Act-Observe流程中，并以JAK2案例演示。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其价值在于把中间工具调用和证据显式保留，便于人工审计端到端设计流程；但JAK2结果主要采用对接、预测pIC50和ADMET等代理指标，不能替代实验命中验证。
items.abstract_zh: 药物发现依赖于跨靶点验证、结构分析、分子设计、可开发性评估和合成可行性的协同决策，但当前计算方法往往是彼此割裂的工具。我们在此介绍TRACEDD（Tool-grounded Reasoning and Agentic Coordination for Explainable Drug Design），一个具有三项主要贡献的框架：（1）建立“工具优先”的多智能体架构，其中LLM编排经验证的计算工具而非取代它们，从而确保科学严谨性；（2）实现模仿专家发现团队的多智能体系统，通过Reason-Act-Observe循环实现透明、可追溯的决策；（3）展示从靶点验证到合成规划的端到端工作流，能够适应现实数据的变异性，例如缺少实验结构的情况。该框架将发现过程拆分为靶点验证、可成药性评估、分子生成、先导优化、ADMET评估、文献证据整合和逆合成等专业智能体，全部通过Reason Act Observe工作流运行。以JAK2为代表性案例，我们表明该系统可检索实验蛋白结构，在结构不可用时调用AlphaFold，识别可成药口袋并进行从头分子生成。已知JAK2抑制剂用于界定设计假设并指导基于强化学习的分子生成；对接评分、预测pIC50及其他理化/ADMET性质作为奖励和优先排序信号。该框架展示了一种工具优先、推理驱动的方法，其中每项主要决策均关联明确的工具调用和中间证据。通过将智能体编排与领域专用计算工具结合，该系统支持透明、可适应且可由人类验证的分子设计工作流，为更可靠的AI辅助药物发现奠定基础。
items.author_line: Vangala, S. R., Kasturi, V. V., Bung, N., Roy, A.

items.title: Genetically-encoded discovery and development of peptide-macrocycle imaging agents for PD-L1
items.abstract_or_text: The unique cell surface composition of tumor cells forms the molecular basis for many targeting and cell-based therapies. Here, we describe the development of novel peptide-based targeting agents for programmed death ligand 1 (PD-L1). Molecular imaging by peptide agents, coupled with therapeutic intervention using the same modality, represents a critical advancement in cancer management. Whole-body PET imaging of PD-L1 expression offers a superior alternative to traditional immuno-histochemistry, making PD-L1 radiodiagnostic imaging a highly sought-after modality. PD-L1 targeting modalities developed for clinical imaging to date can be divided into antibodies, protein domains, and small macrocyclic peptides with fewer than 20 amino acids. The latter modalities can address many challenges seen in antibody-based targeting vectors. All potent PD-L1 targeting peptide modalities reported to date rely extensively on non-canonical amino acids (ncAAs). Here, we report a comprehensive structure-activity relationship (SAR) analysis of a family of macrocycles discovered from an Sx2Cx8Cx2 phage-display library composed entirely of natural amino acids (x represents 19 natural amino acids excluding Cys). Using >10,000 variants in ''focused'' phage-display libraries, we optimized these macrocycles to achieve single-digit-nanomolar potency in protein- and cell-based assays. En route to this optimization, the activity of 216 synthetic macrocycles towards PD-L1 was measured in five distinct assays; two leads have been evaluated by imaging in tumor xenografts in mice, and the X-ray structure of one advanced lead in complex with PD-L1 has been determined at 2.78 [A] resolution. This publication demonstrates the development potential of PD-L1-targeting macrocycles that do not require extensive incorporation of ncAAs and the democratization of discovery by mapping the optimization path to single-digit-nanomolar assets for targeted radiopharmaceuticals via canonical phage-display technology.
items.summary_zh: 研究从全由天然氨基酸组成的Sx2Cx8Cx2噬菌体展示库出发，以逾10,000个变体优化PD-L1肽宏环；216个合成宏环接受五种检测，两个先导物在小鼠异种移植瘤中成像，且一个复合物获得2.78 Å X射线结构。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了兼顾大规模SAR、细胞与体内成像、结构解析的PD-L1靶向肽宏环开发案例，并可减少对非天然氨基酸的依赖；但仍是临床前预印本，人体成像和治疗效用尚未确立。
items.abstract_zh: 肿瘤细胞独特的细胞表面组成构成许多靶向和细胞治疗的分子基础。我们在此描述新型肽类程序性死亡配体1（PD-L1）靶向剂的开发。由肽类药剂进行的分子成像，与利用同一形式进行治疗干预相结合，是癌症管理的重要进步。对PD-L1表达进行全身PET成像是传统免疫组织化学的优越替代方案，使PD-L1放射诊断成像成为高度追求的模式。迄今为临床成像开发的PD-L1靶向方式可分为抗体、蛋白结构域和少于20个氨基酸的小型环肽。后一类方式可解决基于抗体的靶向载体所面临的许多挑战。迄今报道的所有高效PD-L1靶向肽方式均广泛依赖非天然氨基酸（ncAAs）。在此，我们报告了一类从完全由天然氨基酸组成的Sx2Cx8Cx2噬菌体展示文库中发现的宏环的全面构效关系（SAR）分析（x代表除Cys外的19种天然氨基酸）。我们利用逾10,000个变体的“聚焦”噬菌体展示文库优化这些宏环，使其在蛋白和细胞检测中达到单位数纳摩尔效力。在该优化过程中，测定了216个合成宏环在五种不同检测中针对PD-L1的活性；两个先导物已在小鼠肿瘤异种移植模型中接受成像评估，其中一个高级先导物与PD-L1形成复合物的X射线结构已以2.78 Å分辨率解析。本研究展示了不需要广泛引入ncAAs的PD-L1靶向宏环的开发潜力，并通过常规噬菌体展示技术绘制通向用于靶向放射性药物的单位数纳摩尔候选物的优化路径，使发现过程更具可及性。

items.title: A Unified 3D Generative Model for Synthesizable Structure-Based Drug Design
items.abstract_or_text: Traditional screening-based drug discovery is inherently limited by the astronomical scale of the chemical space. Generative modelling offers a compelling alternative to the classical search paradigm and enables rational, bottom-up design of novel and target-specific small molecules. However, its impact has been hampered by challenges in synthetic accessibility of the designed compounds and lack of large-scale experimental validation. Here, we introduce LDDM (Large Drug Discovery Model), a generative framework that supports a range of drug discovery tasks, including constrained and unconstrained docking, fragment linking and growing, and de novo design. We further introduce a programmable design algorithm that enables accurate design of synthetically accessible compounds satisfying various fine-grained objectives. We experimentally validated the designed or optimised ligands for five therapeutically relevant protein targets. In all cases, LDDM achieved high success rates, allowing us to identify molecules with confirmed binding affinity while synthesizing only a small number of generated compounds. The best designs were structurally characterised through NMR spectroscopy and X-ray crystallography, demonstrating high prediction accuracy. Overall, LDDM provides a scalable and flexible platform for the rapid and tailored design of small molecules and non-natural peptides for therapeutic applications.
items.summary_zh: LDDM是支持受限与非受限对接、片段连接/生长和从头设计的三维生成框架，并以可编程算法优化细粒度目标和可合成性；作者在5个治疗相关蛋白靶点上对设计或优化配体进行了实验验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将三维生成直接连接到小规模合成、结合亲和力、NMR和X射线晶体学，验证链条较完整；但靶点数量有限，成功率与可推广性仍需由独立靶点和实际药代安全性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 传统的基于筛选的药物发现受制于化学空间的天文尺度。生成建模为经典搜索范式提供了有力替代方案，并能实现新颖且靶点特异的小分子的理性、自下而上设计。然而，其影响受到所设计化合物可合成性挑战和缺乏大规模实验验证的阻碍。我们在此介绍LDDM（Large Drug Discovery Model），一个支持多种药物发现任务的生成框架，包括受限和非受限对接、片段连接和生长以及从头设计。我们进一步提出一种可编程设计算法，能够准确设计满足各种细粒度目标的可合成化合物。我们对五个具有治疗相关性的蛋白靶点的设计或优化配体进行了实验验证。在所有案例中，LDDM均取得高成功率，仅合成少量生成化合物便使我们鉴定出具有经确认结合亲和力的分子。最佳设计通过NMR光谱和X射线晶体学进行结构表征，显示出很高的预测准确性。总体而言，LDDM为面向治疗应用的小分子和非天然肽的快速、定制化设计提供了可扩展且灵活的平台。

items.title: From Static Material Design to Predictive Open-Loop Control via Chemistry–Architecture Coupling in a Moving-Boundary Reaction–Diffusion Framework
items.abstract_or_text: Bioactive silicate ceramics, wollastonite (CaSiO3), diopside (CaMgSi2O6), and apatite–wollastonite glassceramics constitute a unique class of bone-regeneration materials whose therapeutic action is intrinsically coupled to their own degradation. Yet the field continues to design these materials as static objects, optimizing initial composition, porosity and elastic modulus while evaluating outcomes at fixed endpoints, tacitly ignoring the central fact that the physicochemical microenvironment they create evolves continuously and irreversibly. We argue that this temporal evolution is not a side effect but the therapeutic mechanism itself, and that it can be engineered predictively. This review consolidates and mathematically hardens the emerging paradigm of spatiotemporal trajectory engineering: the pre-encoded, open-loop programming of a degrading scaffold’s full physicochemical trajectory through coupled control of ceramic network chemistry and pore-network architecture. Three advances over prior treatments are delivered. First, the solid-state chemistry foundation is deepened: Qn speciation from 29Si MAS-NMR is mapped onto hydration versus hydrolysis activation barriers; the incongruent dissolution cascade (cation exchange → silica-gel layer → hydroxycarbonate apatite nucleation) is formalized as a coupled surface–gel-layer–precipitation problem; and the autocatalytic OH−-feedback loop that drives local pH spikes is quantified, together with surface-specific XPS O 1s BO/NBO deconvolution as the front-tracking metric. Second, the static reaction–diffusion model is upgraded to a moving-boundary erosion formulation: an explicit porosity-evolution law, a dynamically self-consistent effective diffusivity, and interstitial convective (Brinkman) transport are introduced, yielding a two-dimensional Damköhler–Péclet regime map that delineates four phenomenologically distinct trajectory regimes, reaction-limited, diffusion-limited, convective washout, and convection-amplified dosing, plus a coupled design corridor where trajectory classes diverge maximally. Third, biological admissibility is replaced from discrete endpoint thresholds to a continuous phase-indexed Regenerative Target Zone (RTZ) envelope incorporating M1-gating, M2-switch, and HCA-maturation kinetics; and the computational pipeline is extended with functional data analysis (fPCA, DTW), neural ordinary differential equations, physicsinformed neural networks, Hamiltonian Monte Carlo credible tubes, and Bayesian-optimal experimental design. The resulting framework is fully specified, falsifiable, and implementable with open-source tools and standard instrumentation. It reclassifies the design problem from optimizing a material to programming an evolving microenvironment, and because the temporal program is pre-encoded without biological sensing, it qualifies as a passive implant under current regulatory frameworks.
items.summary_zh: 文章提出以陶瓷网络化学和孔网络结构的耦合，预编码可降解生物活性硅酸盐支架的时空理化轨迹；框架结合移动边界反应—扩散模型、RTZ生物学包络及PINN、HMC和贝叶斯实验设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将骨再生材料从静态配方优化转向可检验的时序微环境设计，连接材料化学、输运和生物反应；但这是综述和建模框架，尚未报告其端到端预测控制的实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 生物活性硅酸盐陶瓷、硅灰石（CaSiO3）、透辉石（CaMgSi2O6）和磷灰石—硅灰石玻璃陶瓷构成一类独特的骨再生材料，其治疗作用与自身降解内在耦合。然而，该领域仍将这些材料设计为静态物体，优化初始组成、孔隙率和弹性模量，并在固定终点评估结果，实际上忽略了它们所创造的理化微环境会持续且不可逆演变这一核心事实。我们认为，这种时间演变不是副作用，而是治疗机制本身，并且可被预测性工程化。本综述整合并以数学方式强化了时空轨迹工程这一新兴范式：通过对陶瓷网络化学和孔网络结构的耦合控制，预编码、开环编程降解支架的完整理化轨迹。本文相较既有论述提出三项进展。第一，加深固态化学基础：将29Si MAS-NMR的Qn物种分布映射至水化与水解活化势垒；将非一致溶解级联过程（阳离子交换→硅胶层→羟基碳酸盐磷灰石成核）形式化为耦合的表面—凝胶层—沉淀问题；量化驱动局部pH尖峰的自催化OH−反馈环，并将表面特异的XPS O 1s BO/NBO解卷积作为前沿跟踪指标。第二，将静态反应—扩散模型升级为移动边界侵蚀表述：引入显式孔隙率演化律、动态自洽的有效扩散率和间质对流（Brinkman）输运，由此得到二维Damköhler–Péclet状态图，划分四种现象学上不同的轨迹状态——反应受限、扩散受限、对流冲刷和对流增强给药——以及轨迹类别分歧最大的耦合设计走廊。第三，以连续、分期索引的再生靶区（RTZ）包络替代离散终点阈值，其中纳入M1门控、M2转换和HCA成熟动力学；计算流程还扩展了函数数据分析（fPCA、DTW）、神经常微分方程、物理信息神经网络、Hamiltonian Monte Carlo可信区间带和贝叶斯最优实验设计。所得框架已被完整规定、可证伪，并可利用开源工具和标准仪器实施。它将设计问题重新界定为对演化微环境进行编程，而非优化一种材料；由于该时间程序在没有生物传感的情况下被预编码，按现行监管框架可被认定为被动植入物。

items.title: Agentic Workflow for High-Throughput Synthesis Campaigns: Mapping the Persistent Phosphor Ca2ZnSi2O7:Eu2+,Nd3+
items.abstract_or_text: The structural and spectroscopic record of a high-throughput synthesis campaign exceeds what experimenters can closely and accurately analyze with conventional tools alone. We report a workflow built for this problem: a language model agent operates an automated Rietveld phasesearch pipeline, Crystalyze Match, built on the open-source DARA engine, and then interprets the phases, optical spectra, and synthesis metadata. We demonstrate this workflow on a 48 sample campaign for the persistent phosphor Ca 2 ZnSi 2 O 7 :Eu 2+ ,Nd 3+ (doped hardystonite), a water-stable candidate alternative to SrAl 2 O 4 :Eu 2+ ,Dy 3+ for luminescent road markings. Within the campaign’s lifetime, the workflow mapped two decomposition pathways, incomplete reaction and zinc volatilization, that validate the two-step synthetic approach. The workflow also identified the fate of the rare-earth dopants: a silicate oxyapatite, Ca 2 (Eu,Nd) 8 (SiO 4 ) 6 O 2 , missed by prior manual analysis, is present in every doped sample. Human adjudication proved necessary as the search first scored the oxyapatite through a lanthanide-free proxy structure that scatters too weakly to register at low fractions, and a corrected-model re-screen of all 48 patterns recovered it. Though the rare-earth dopants appear to end up in the oxyapatite phase, emission rises monotonically with Eu content, and the material shows the target persistent luminescence, so where the emitting Eu 2+ resides remains unresolved. Our work highlights that human review and re-screening after every structure-model revision dramatically improve the trustworthiness of campaign-scale claims.
items.summary_zh: 该工作用语言模型智能体驱动基于DARA的自动Rietveld相检索流程，对48个Ca2ZnSi2O7:Eu2+,Nd3+长余辉体样品的结构、光谱和合成元数据进行联读，并经人工复核发现所有掺杂样品均含稀土硅酸盐氧磷灰石。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了智能体辅助高通量材料研究中“模型修订后重筛+人工裁决”对避免错误相鉴定的必要性；Eu2+实际发光位点仍未解析，工作流的可靠性不能仅凭自动评分判断。
items.abstract_zh: 高通量合成活动的结构和光谱记录超出了实验人员仅依靠常规工具能够细致且准确分析的范围。我们报告了一个为此问题构建的工作流：语言模型智能体运行建立在开源DARA引擎上的自动Rietveld相检索流程Crystalyze Match，随后解释相、光谱和合成元数据。我们在Ca2ZnSi2O7:Eu2+,Nd3+（掺杂硬硅钙石）的48个样品活动中展示该工作流；这种材料是用于发光道路标线的耐水SrAl2O4:Eu2+,Dy3+的候选替代品。在活动期间，该工作流绘制出两条分解路径——反应不完全和锌挥发——验证了两步合成方法。工作流还识别出稀土掺杂剂的去向：此前人工分析遗漏的一种硅酸盐氧磷灰石Ca2(Eu,Nd)8(SiO4)6O2存在于每一个掺杂样品中。人工裁决被证明是必要的，因为该检索起初通过一种镧系元素自由的代理结构对氧磷灰石评分；该结构在低含量时散射太弱而无法检出。随后对全部48张衍射图进行经修正模型的重新筛查，恢复了该相。尽管稀土掺杂剂似乎最终进入氧磷灰石相，发射强度随Eu含量单调上升且材料表现出目标长余辉发光，因此发光Eu2+的实际所在位置仍未解决。我们的工作强调，在每次结构模型修订后进行人工审查和重新筛查，会显著提高活动规模结论的可信度。
items.author_line: Ziyang Jiang, Eric Riesel, Ian Naccarella, Taylor D. Sparks

items.title: Machine Learning for Toxicity Prediction in Low-Sample Molecular Classes
items.abstract_or_text: Deep learning models such as Chemprop have advanced quantitative molecular property prediction, but their reliance on large training sets limits use in data-scarce domains. We propose a framework that fine-tunes a general baseline model trained on publicly available data on small, class-specific datasets. The resulting models retain the baseline's generalization ability while gaining class-specific accuracy and produce probabilistic outputs that capture uncertainty in the training data. We demonstrate the approach on three toxicity classes defined by a common core structure, target, or mode of action: (i) organophosphates, (ii) androgen receptor antagonists, and (iii) estrogen receptor beta antagonists. Each fine-tuned model outperforms classical machine-learning methods and the EPA TEST tool. The probabilistic nature of the predictions enables prioritization of compounds for experimental validation and seamless integration with data streams of varying quality, supporting iterative decision-making in chemical safety and drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 研究以公开数据预训练的Chemprop基线模型为起点，在小型类别特异数据集上微调，分别预测有机磷化合物、雄激素受体拮抗剂和雌激素受体β拮抗剂的毒性，并输出不确定性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对低样本化学类别提出可与实验优先级排序衔接的迁移学习方案，且报告优于经典机器学习和EPA TEST；但小数据微调仍可能受化学空间覆盖和训练数据质量限制。
items.abstract_zh: Chemprop等深度学习模型推动了定量分子性质预测，但其对大型训练集的依赖限制了其在数据稀缺领域的应用。我们提出一个框架：在小型、类别特异数据集上微调一个利用公开数据训练的通用基线模型。所得模型在保留基线泛化能力的同时获得类别特异的准确性，并产生能够捕获训练数据中不确定性的概率输出。我们在由共同核心结构、靶点或作用机制定义的三类毒性类别上展示该方法：（i）有机磷化合物，（ii）雄激素受体拮抗剂，及（iii）雌激素受体β拮抗剂。每个微调模型均优于经典机器学习方法和EPA TEST工具。预测的概率性质使得化合物可被优先安排进入实验验证，并可与不同质量的数据流无缝整合，从而支持化学安全和药物发现中的迭代决策。
items.author_line: Barajas, C., Dunphy, L., Mullany, L., Tiburzi, O., Lloyd, E.

items.title: A Molecular Generation–Validation Workflow Combining Reversible Junction Tree Reinforcement Learning and Semi-empirical Quantum Chemistry: A Case Study on Molecular Solar Thermal Fuels
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular generative models can rapidly explore chemical space, but conventional metrics alone do not establish whether proposed structures possess application-relevant physical properties. To address this limitation, we developed an integrated generationvalidation framework coupling Reversible Junction Tree Reinforcement Learning (RJT- RL) with automated density-functional tight-binding (DFTB) evaluation. Azobenzenebased molecular solar thermal fuels served as a representative case study. RJT-RL was guided by maximum Tanimoto similarity to a reference dataset, while reference and generated molecules were evaluated under identical DFTB calculation conditions to obtain the energy difference between the cis and trans isomers (∆ E iso ) and the S 0 → S 1 excitation energy (∆ E ex ). As training progressed, the ∆ E iso distribution extended toward higher values, while ∆ E ex values were more concentrated within the visible-light window, yielding candidates within the selected joint screening region, although neither descriptor was included in the reward. These results show that automated semi-empirical post-generation validation can identify candidates with targeted property combinations and reveal information beyond conventional molecular generation metrics.
items.summary_zh: 工作将Reversible Junction Tree Reinforcement Learning（RJT-RL）与自动DFTB计算结合，在偶氮苯分子太阳能热燃料案例中，以统一条件评估cis/trans异构体能差ΔEiso及S0→S1激发能ΔEex。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 强调生成模型常用指标不足以证明应用相关物性，并给出自动量化后验证方案；但结果仍基于半经验量子化学筛选，未报告合成、光化学循环或储能实验。
items.abstract_zh: 分子生成模型能够快速探索化学空间，但仅靠常规指标无法确立所提出结构是否具备应用相关的物理性质。为解决这一局限，我们开发了一个整合的生成—验证框架，将Reversible Junction Tree Reinforcement Learning（RJT-RL）与自动化密度泛函紧束缚（DFTB）评估相耦合。以偶氮苯类分子太阳能热燃料作为代表性案例。RJT-RL由相对于参考数据集的最大Tanimoto相似度引导，而参考分子和生成分子均在相同的DFTB计算条件下评估，以获得cis和trans异构体之间的能量差（ΔEiso）以及S0→S1激发能（ΔEex）。随着训练推进，ΔEiso分布向更高数值延伸，而ΔEex值更集中于可见光窗口，产生了落在所选联合筛选区域内的候选物，尽管这两个描述符均未被纳入奖励。这些结果表明，生成后自动化半经验验证可识别具有目标性质组合的候选物，并揭示超出常规分子生成指标的信息。
items.author_line: Qingyu Zhu, Ryan Lingg, Reuben Szabo, Tim Kowalczyk, Daisuke Yokogawa

items.title: Generative Design of New-to-nature Biosynthetic Assembly Lines with Genomic Language Modeling
items.abstract_or_text: Reprogramming biosynthetic assembly lines can extend biosynthesis beyond the chemical space explored by nature. However, this remains difficult because assembly-line function depends on coordinated interactions across large multidomain enzymes. Here, we couple gLM2, a genomic language model trained on metagenomic sequences, with discrete diffusion and domain-level conditioning to enable generative design and optimization of biosynthetic gene clusters. We apply this approach to a chimeric type I polyketide synthase (PKS) engineered to produce {delta}-valerolactam, a molecule not naturally synthesized by PKSs. Through iterative redesign of two multi-domain regions in the context of the full PKS sequence, gLM2 progressively improved {delta}-valerolactam production, yielding variants with up to 9.4-fold higher titer than the starting enzyme. Together, these results demonstrate that evolutionary sequence information can be learned and applied to complex, multi-domain enzyme design problems, expanding biosynthetic assembly lines to produce molecules outside their natural biosynthetic repertoire.
items.summary_zh: 作者以在宏基因组序列上训练的基因组语言模型gLM2、离散扩散和结构域条件化设计嵌合I型PKS；经两段多结构域区域迭代重设计，δ-valerolactam滴度最高提高9.4-fold。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为复杂多结构域生物合成装配线的生成式改造提供了实际产量验证，而非只报告序列指标；但验证集中于一个PKS和产物，跨酶系与工业过程的泛化仍待检验。
items.abstract_zh: 对生物合成装配线进行重新编程可以将生物合成扩展到自然界已探索化学空间之外。然而，这仍然困难，因为装配线功能依赖大型多结构域酶之间的协调相互作用。我们在此将gLM2——一个在宏基因组序列上训练的基因组语言模型——与离散扩散和结构域层面的条件化相结合，以实现生物合成基因簇的生成式设计和优化。我们将该方法应用于经工程化以生产δ-valerolactam的嵌合I型聚酮合酶（PKS）；δ-valerolactam是一种并非由PKS天然合成的分子。通过在完整PKS序列背景下对两个多结构域区域进行迭代再设计，gLM2逐步提高了δ-valerolactam产量，所得变体的滴度最高达到起始酶的9.4-fold。总体而言，这些结果表明，进化序列信息可以被学习并应用于复杂多结构域酶设计问题，将生物合成装配线扩展至生产超出其天然生物合成谱系的分子。
items.author_line: Lanclos, N., Ibrahim, K., Cornman, A., Huang, M., Gill, V., Jiang, A., Abraham, J., Gin, J., Chen, Y., Petzold, C., Baerwald, J., Kortemme, T., Keasling, J., Hwang, Y.

items.title: Uni-Macro-FRPN: Full-Resolution and Cross-Scale Learning for Polymers
items.abstract_or_text: Polymer properties are governed by interactions across scales. Existing polymer models commonly retain either monomer chemistry without the polymer graph, or the polymer graph with simplified monomer chemistry. Here, we present Uni-Macro-FRPN (FRPN), a Full-Resolution Polymer Network unifying atom-level and within-monomer structural encoding with an explicit monomer-instance graph of a polymer chain. Its two Transformers jointly learn atom-informed monomer semantics, sequence order, and chain topology. Using BigSMILES to construct monomer semantics and polymer graphs, FRPN achieves 86.4% accuracy and 90.6% ROC–AUC on Block Copolymer Database (BCDB) lamellar-versus-non-lamellar classification, outperforming the evaluated baselines and supporting joint reasoning over monomer semantics and chain structure. Ablation results support a contribution from joint representation beyond the tested increases in parameter count. On the linear homopolymer benchmark, monomer-centric learning remains competitive, identifying a boundary case in which polymer-scale organization is relatively simple. In addition, existing models are primarily developed around linear polymers. To test whether this full-chain representation generalizes beyond linear polymers, we construct an all-atom moleculardynamics (MD) benchmark of 1640 datapoints spanning diverse monomer chemistries, sequence orderings, chain topologies, and physical properties. FRPN achieves the strongest overall performance on this topology-rich benchmark, and the accompanying diagnostics suggest a benefit from jointly modeling monomer chemistry and polymer structure within one architecture. Taken together, FRPN provides a practical route for moving polymer representation learning beyond SMILESbased descriptions by using BigSMILES to connect monomer semantics with explicit polymer-chain topology, and establishes a foundation for full-chain, cross-scale polymer modeling. Its leading overall performance among the evaluated models on both the real-world BCDB benchmark and the topology-rich MD benchmark further suggests a promising direction for polymer informatics: future polymer prediction models should treat polymers not only as collections of monomer descriptors, but as complete multiscale chemical and topological objects.
items.summary_zh: Uni-Macro-FRPN以BigSMILES构建单体语义和聚合物图，用两个Transformer共同表示原子层面信息、单体顺序和链拓扑；在BCDB及1,640条全原子MD拓扑丰富基准上优于所比较基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该表示将聚合物化学与整链拓扑并入同一模型，补足仅用SMILES或仅用简化图的局限；结论基于特定分类和MD基准，尚需在真实材料性质与外部数据上验证。
items.abstract_zh: 聚合物性质受跨尺度相互作用支配。现有聚合物模型通常要么保留单体化学而没有聚合物图，要么保留聚合物图而简化单体化学。我们在此提出Uni-Macro-FRPN（FRPN），一种全分辨率聚合物网络，它统一原子层面和单体内结构编码，并显式构建聚合物链的单体实例图。其两个Transformer共同学习由原子信息支撑的单体语义、序列顺序和链拓扑。利用BigSMILES构建单体语义和聚合物图，FRPN在Block Copolymer Database（BCDB）的层状/非层状分类上取得86.4%准确率和90.6% ROC–AUC，优于所评估的基线，并支持对单体语义与链结构的联合推理。消融结果支持联合表示的贡献，这一贡献超出所测试的参数量增加所带来的影响。在直链均聚物基准上，以单体为中心的学习仍具竞争力，指出了聚合物尺度组织相对简单的边界情形。此外，现有模型主要围绕线性聚合物开发。为检验这种全链表示能否泛化至线性聚合物之外，我们构建了一个包含1,640个数据点的全原子分子动力学（MD）基准，覆盖多样的单体化学、序列顺序、链拓扑和物理性质。FRPN在该拓扑丰富基准上取得最强的总体性能，随附诊断表明，在一个架构中联合建模单体化学和聚合物结构具有益处。综上，FRPN通过使用BigSMILES将单体语义与显式聚合物链拓扑相连，为使聚合物表示学习超越基于SMILES的描述提供了实用途径，并为全链、跨尺度聚合物建模奠定基础。其在真实世界BCDB基准和拓扑丰富MD基准上均在所评估模型中取得领先总体性能，进一步表明聚合物信息学的一个有前景方向：未来聚合物预测模型应将聚合物不仅视为单体描述符的集合，也应视为完整的多尺度化学和拓扑对象。
items.author_line: Jintao Wu, Yiran Shan, Rui Zhang

items.title: A traceable agentic framework for chemistry research query and analysis with ThermoML database
items.abstract_or_text: Reliable use of thermophysical databases in exploratory chemistry requires resolving heterogeneous identifiers, reconciling experimental conditions, and preserving numerical provenance across large, nested records. We present a hierarchical large language model (LLM) agent framework, implemented with a custom ReAct reasoning engine, that translates naturallanguage research questions into traceable retrieval and analysis workflows over the NIST ThermoML database. The framework combines hierarchical canonical identifiers, queryconditioned evidence compaction, deterministic inspection ledgers and numerical-grounding gates, and tool-assisted Redlich–Kister fitting. Five case studies are discussed in detail, representing chemistry tasks spanning data-rich and data-sparse retrieval, binary-mixture correlation, and open-ended cosolvent screening. For an ethanol–water equimolar density query, the system reduced ~190k characters of search output to 2k and precisely recovered a measured density of 859.3 kg m-3 at an ethanol mole fraction of 0.498, 298.15 K, and 100 kPa. For methanolethanol viscosity, it selected condition-aligned mixture and pure-component records, examined the fitting results at different orders, and produced a 2nd-order Redlich–Kister fit with 𝑅 = 0.982. Results for an open-ended iron-electrodeposition electrolyte design query synthesized evidence from approximately 12k measurements across 200 data blocks. However, with numerical grounding disabled for this specific case, the answer contained severe numerical hallucinations despite qualitatively coherent reasoning. These cases establish the feasibility of agent-assisted ThermoML research and identify identity management, evidence compaction, and deterministic numerical provenance as central design requirements for reliable chemistry-database research agents with some level of abstraction chemistry reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 该层级LLM智能体框架以自定义ReAct引擎把自然语言问题转为可追溯的NIST ThermoML检索和分析流程，结合规范化标识符、证据压缩、确定性检查账本、数值落地门和Redlich–Kister拟合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 作者用案例定量展示了可追溯检索和数值来源控制的价值，并诚实报告关闭数值落地后发生严重数值幻觉；因此其可靠性依赖于这些硬性验证门是否真正启用。
items.abstract_zh: 在探索性化学中可靠使用热物性数据库，需要解析异质标识符、协调实验条件，并在大型嵌套记录中保留数值溯源。我们提出一个层级大语言模型（LLM）智能体框架，采用定制ReAct推理引擎实现，将自然语言研究问题转译为针对NIST ThermoML数据库的可追溯检索和分析工作流。该框架结合层级规范标识符、查询条件化证据压缩、确定性检查账本和数值落地门，以及工具辅助的Redlich–Kister拟合。文章详细讨论五个案例研究，代表从数据丰富和数据稀缺检索、二元混合物关联到开放式助溶剂筛选的化学任务。对于乙醇—水等摩尔密度查询，系统将约190k字符的检索输出压缩至2k，并精确恢复了乙醇摩尔分数0.498、298.15 K和100 kPa下859.3 kg m-3的实测密度。对于甲醇—乙醇黏度，它选择了条件匹配的混合物和纯组分记录，检查不同阶数的拟合结果，并给出二阶Redlich–Kister拟合，R = 0.982。对于开放式铁电沉积电解液设计查询，结果综合了约200个数据块中的12k项测量；然而，在这个特定案例中关闭数值落地后，回答虽在定性推理上连贯，却包含严重的数值幻觉。这些案例确立了智能体辅助ThermoML研究的可行性，并指出标识管理、证据压缩和确定性数值溯源是实现具有一定抽象化学推理能力的可靠化学数据库研究智能体的核心设计要求。
items.author_line: Yunkai Sun, Adwaith Ravichandran, Hassan Harb, Rajeev S. Assary, Brian J. Ingram, Zhenzhen Yang

items.title: High-throughput physics-based enzyme engineering
items.abstract_or_text: Enzyme engineering aims to tailor natural enzymes for industrial and therapeutic applications, yet physically grounded rational design has been limited by a trade-off between accuracy and cost, leaving the field heavily dependent on expert intuition. Here we present a scalable physics-based framework that combines field-aware machine learning with molecular mechanics to capture enzyme electrostatics at quantum-mechanical accuracy while enabling efficient, atomistic exploration of reaction free-energy landscapes. Coupled with microkinetic modelling, the framework translates molecular free-energy landscapes into catalytic rates and selectivity across competing, multistep reaction pathways. Applied to a newly engineered oxidative amidase (OxiAm), the framework predicts catalytic rate constants with near-experimental accuracy, quantitatively resolves the selectivity between hydrolysis and aminolysis, and generalizes across substrates, mutations and enzyme homologues. Transition-state ensemble analysis further reveals the reaction mechanism and guides the design of enzyme variants for pharmaceutical synthesis. By bringing chemical accuracy and high-throughput sampling to enzyme catalysis, this approach shifts rational design from static, empirical practice toward dynamic, free-energy-driven design, and should accelerate the engineering of biocatalysts.
items.summary_zh: 研究将场感知机器学习、分子力学、微观动力学和反应自由能景观结合，用于高通量、物理驱动的酶工程；在氧化酰胺酶OxiAm上预测速率常数、解析水解/氨解选择性，并指导药物合成变体设计。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把近量子精度的酶电静力学与可扩展采样和实验速率相连，有望提升理性生物催化设计效率；但其验证聚焦于OxiAm，方法成本及对更多反应类别的泛化仍需评估。
items.abstract_zh: 酶工程旨在为工业和治疗应用定制天然酶，但以物理为基础的理性设计长期受到准确性与成本权衡的限制，使该领域高度依赖专家直觉。我们在此提出一个可扩展的物理驱动框架，结合场感知机器学习和分子力学，以量子力学准确度捕捉酶电静力学，同时实现对反应自由能景观的高效原子级探索。该框架与微观动力学建模耦合，可将分子自由能景观转化为竞争性多步反应路径上的催化速率和选择性。应用于新工程化的氧化酰胺酶（OxiAm）时，该框架以接近实验的准确度预测催化速率常数，定量解析水解和氨解之间的选择性，并可跨底物、突变和酶同源物泛化。过渡态系综分析进一步揭示反应机制，并指导用于药物合成的酶变体设计。通过为酶催化带来化学准确度和高通量采样，该方法将理性设计从静态、经验性实践转向动态、自由能驱动的设计，并有望加速生物催化剂工程。
items.author_line: Wang, X., Qiu, X., Wu, Y., Niu, T., Zhang, S., Gao, R., Cho, I., Tang, H., Hu, K., Lei, X., Isayev, O., Wang, J.

items.title: Controlled Blood-Brain Barrier Modulation by a High-Affinity Claudin-5 Peptide Binder
items.abstract_or_text: The blood-brain barrier (BBB) is a specialized interface that tightly regulates the exchange of molecules between the bloodstream and the brain. Its barrier function relies on a monolayer of brain endothelial cells sealed by tight junctions (TJs) that restrict paracellular flux through claudin-5 (CLDN5) multimeric complexes. To improve the delivery of nutrients and drugs to the brain, CLDN5-competitive peptides are promising carriers for creating size-controlled, temporary openings in the paracellular pathway. Here, we combine generative protein design and atomistic simulations to design ST9, a peptide with high nanomolar affinity for CLDN5. Compared with f1-C5C2, a CLDN5-binding peptide that we previously reported, ST9 induces a rapid, transient, size-controlled, and fully reversible increase in paracellular permeability, without altering CLDN5 expression or the proteomic profile of brain endothelial cells, indicating distinct mechanisms of TJ destabilization. This work provides a promising approach for developing next-generation BBB-opening agents to effectively treat neurological diseases.
items.summary_zh: 作者结合生成式蛋白设计与原子级模拟，得到对CLDN5具高纳摩尔亲和力的肽ST9；相较f1-C5C2，ST9可快速、短暂、尺寸可控且完全可逆地提高旁细胞通透性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为可控开放血脑屏障以递送脑部药物提供新的肽结合剂与机制线索；但摘要未报告动物递送或治疗实验，屏障调节的体内安全窗和长期影响仍是关键问题。
items.abstract_zh: 血脑屏障（BBB）是一个高度特化的界面，严格调控血液与大脑之间分子的交换。其屏障功能依赖于由紧密连接（TJs）密封的脑内皮细胞单层，紧密连接通过claudin-5（CLDN5）多聚复合物限制旁细胞通量。为改善营养物和药物向大脑的递送，与CLDN5竞争的肽是很有前景的载体，可在旁细胞通路中形成尺寸可控的暂时开口。我们在此结合生成式蛋白设计和原子级模拟，设计出ST9——一种对CLDN5具有高纳摩尔亲和力的肽。与我们此前报道的CLDN5结合肽f1-C5C2相比，ST9可诱导快速、短暂、尺寸可控且完全可逆的旁细胞通透性增加，而不改变CLDN5表达或脑内皮细胞的蛋白质组特征，这表明其紧密连接失稳机制不同。本工作为开发下一代BBB开放剂以有效治疗神经系统疾病提供了有前景的方法。
items.author_line: Berselli, A., Trevisani, M., Alberini, G., Pastore, A., Di Fonzo, A., Armirotti, A., Castagnola, V., Maragliano, L., Benfenati, F.

items.title: Physical priors improve performance of structure-based binding affinity models
items.abstract_or_text: Structure-based drug discovery is a widely used paradigm for the rational design of novel small molecule therapeutics. However, the benefits conferred by the use of structural information has seen limited adoption in machine learning, where ligand-only ("2D") models are still the industry standard for molecular property or binding affinity prediction. Structure-based ("3D") ML models for binding-affinity prediction promise to present a clear advantage, but have not yet overtaken existing 2D models. Here, we show that physics-based priors can improve predictive performance of structure-based models by comparing different model architectures with varying physical priors on several prediction tasks. We present the Modular Training and Evaluation of Neural Networks (mtenn) package, where we decompose affinity prediction into separate steps of embedding structure into learned representations and combining those embeddings into a predicted binding affinity. We consider both E(3)-invariant and E(3)-equivariant architectures to determine the importance of encoding roto-translational inductive biases, as well as different methods for combining learned embeddings. By first optimizing several aspects of model construction using the general purpose PDBBind dataset, we are able to improve the performance and data efficiency of structure-based models. When subsequently trained and evaluated on the COVID Moonshot small molecule drug discovery dataset, our tuned models perform on par with industry standard ligand-only models. Our decomposed model framework highlights that encoding some physical priors improves model performance, while more complex biases such as equivariance offer limited benefit. Additionally, structure-based models generalize better to an unseen target and display higher training efficiency. Overall, these results emphasize that structure-based models benefit from their ability to incorporate physics-informed constraints, giving promising directions for model architecture development. These results also suggest that the strength of these models may be in tasks specifically aimed at generalizability, providing guidelines for their use in early-stage drug discovery campaigns.
items.summary_zh: 作者在PDBBind和COVID Moonshot数据集上比较具有不同物理先验的结构型结合亲和力模型，并发布mtenn框架；调优后的3D模型与行业标准2D配体模型持平，对未见靶点泛化更好。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 明确检验了旋转—平移归纳偏置等物理先验的实际收益，为结构型亲和力模型设计提供实证边界；性能仍与强2D模型相当而非显著超越，且依赖所用数据集和划分方式。
items.abstract_zh: 基于结构的药物发现是理性设计新型小分子治疗剂的广泛应用范式。然而，在机器学习中，使用结构信息带来的益处尚未得到广泛采用；仅配体（“2D”）模型仍是分子性质或结合亲和力预测的行业标准。用于结合亲和力预测的基于结构（“3D”）机器学习模型有望呈现明确优势，但尚未超越现有2D模型。我们在此通过比较具有不同物理先验的模型架构在若干预测任务上的表现，表明基于物理的先验能够提升结构型模型的预测性能。我们提出Modular Training and Evaluation of Neural Networks（mtenn）软件包，在其中将亲和力预测拆分为：把结构嵌入为学习得到的表征，以及组合这些嵌入以得到预测结合亲和力。我们考察E(3)-不变和E(3)-等变架构，以确定编码旋转—平移归纳偏置的重要性，并比较组合学习嵌入的不同方法。首先在通用PDBBind数据集上优化模型构建的若干方面后，我们能够提高结构型模型的性能和数据效率。随后在COVID Moonshot小分子药物发现数据集上训练和评估时，调优模型的表现与行业标准的仅配体模型相当。我们的分解式模型框架表明，编码某些物理先验可提高模型性能，而等变性等更复杂偏置的收益有限。此外，结构型模型对未见靶点泛化更好，并显示出更高训练效率。总体而言，这些结果强调，结构型模型受益于纳入物理信息约束的能力，为模型架构开发提供有前景的方向。这些结果还表明，这类模型的优势可能在于专门针对泛化能力的任务，并为其在早期药物发现活动中的使用提供指南。
items.author_line: Kaminow, B., Payne, A. M., MacDermott-Opeskin, H. I., Chodera, J. D., Singh, S.

items.title: Latent generative search unlocks de novo design of untapped biomolecular interactions at scale
items.abstract_or_text: De novo protein design has advanced rapidly, yet designing binders to polar, solvent-exposed epitopes and small, flexible ligands remains challenging. Such hydrated surfaces and flexible molecules, including carbohydrates, provide few of the hydrophobic contacts favoured by current methods and have largely resisted de novo binders. To address this challenge, here we introduce latent generative search for binder design, a novel framework that uses reward-guided search at inference time to steer the Proteina-Complexa generative model. The model codesigns sequence and structure - generating them together in a continuous latent space - and thereby removes the inverse-folding step on which current methods rely. In a screen of more than one million designs by multiplexed phage display, latent generative search produced more validated binders than every other method tested, its codesigned sequences surpassing post hoc redesign. It delivered high-affinity binders across therapeutic receptors, a viral attachment protein and intracellular signalling targets. Our approach also accessed previously untapped biology, generating the first de novo proteins that bind a free carbohydrate, including one that discriminates between blood-group antigens - a polar, flexible target class beyond the reach of current design methods.
items.summary_zh: 文章提出在推理时以奖励引导的潜在生成搜索，驱动Proteina-Complexa在连续潜在空间共同设计序列和结构；逾一百万个设计经多重噬菌体展示筛选，获得针对受体、病毒蛋白和胞内靶点的结合剂，并首次从头设计出游离碳水化合物结合蛋白。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将大规模湿实验筛选与新型序列—结构协同生成连接，突破了极性、溶剂暴露和柔性靶点的设计难题；比较结果仍受所测试方法、筛选条件和验证体系限定，体内可开发性需另行确认。
items.abstract_zh: 从头蛋白设计进展迅速，但为极性、溶剂暴露表位以及小而柔性的配体设计结合剂仍然困难。这类水合表面和柔性分子（包括碳水化合物）几乎不提供当前方法偏好的疏水接触，且在很大程度上仍难以获得从头设计结合剂。为解决这一挑战，我们在此介绍用于结合剂设计的潜在生成搜索，这是一种新框架，在推理时使用奖励引导搜索来操控Proteina-Complexa生成模型。该模型共同设计序列和结构——在连续潜在空间中同时生成二者——从而消除了当前方法所依赖的逆折叠步骤。在对超过一百万个设计进行多重噬菌体展示筛选时，潜在生成搜索产生的经验证结合剂多于每一种其他受测方法，其共同设计的序列优于事后重设计。该方法为治疗性受体、病毒附着蛋白和胞内信号靶点提供了高亲和力结合剂。我们的方法还进入了此前未被开发的生物学领域，生成了首批可结合游离碳水化合物的从头设计蛋白，其中包括一种可区分血型抗原的蛋白——这是当前设计方法难以触及的极性、柔性靶点类别。
